text:
olivia (support): customers reporting 502/504s from hosted API since ~2026-03-17 03:10 UTC. Most hits on /v1/embeddings (large batch jobs). sample req id: req=1767894321-acme, trace=acme-8a3f.

mike (eng-sre): seeing spike on edge h2 conn metrics — keepalive pool exhaustion on midfronts + a burst of auth cache misses. envoy logs show upstream reset (RST_STREAM) and a few 504s when requests queued too long.

lex (eng-runtime): large embedding batches open long-lived streams and hold kv cache / connections. if auth TTL rotates and triggers revalidation, auth proxy fanout can cause conn-window collision. not classic CPU issue.

olivia (support): customer repro steps (from them): "POST /v1/embeddings" with 250 items in payload, streaming enabled. they used chunked upload and saw intermittent 502s after ~10s.

sarah (support): customer report: "first 60s OK, then intermittent 502s for ~30m, then fell back after you throttled us" — they pasted one response: 
HTTP/2 502
content-type: application/json
{"error":"upstream connection reset"}

mike (eng-sre): pulled envoy stdout: 
"[2026-03-17T03:11:05.123Z] \"POST /v1/embeddings\" 502 UPGRADE_FAILED upstream_reset
upstream: midfront-12, cluster: auth-midproxy, trace=acme-8a3f"

deploy-bot: rolled hotfix envoy config -> increased http/2 connection pool size on midfronts (+20%) at 03:25 UTC.

jamie (oncall): immediate mitigation applied: 1) throttle per-tenant concurrent streams for /v1/embeddings to 8; 2) bumped midfront conn pool; 3) temporary auth-cache heartbeat disabled to avoid mass revalidations. monitoring now.

lex (eng-runtime): short-term notes: keepalive headroom was too low given long-lived streaming. we should add an adaptive window: conn window headroom tied to rolling 5m stream length.

olivia (support): repro curl to show how they hit it (customer payload sanitized):
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \\ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\ 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \\ 
  -d '{"input": ["long text ... repeated 250 times"], "stream": true}'
```
response example: HTTP/2 502 after ~11s.

mike (eng-sre): commands I used to inspect pods: 
```
kubectl -n edge logs deploy/envoy-midfront-12 | grep "upstream_reset" -A2 -B2
kubectl -n edge top pod envoy-midfront-12
```
we also saw socket queue length spike (`ss -s`) on those nodes.

jamie (oncall): customer acme confirmed after throttling: 502s->0, 504s rare, overall 95p latency back to baseline. they asked for permanent fix.

sarah (support): customer follow-up: wants recommended client-side backoff and batch size guidance.

olivia (support): immediate action items: 
- publish short KB: "edge connection window & embeddings: best practices" (support owner: sarah)
- runtime/eng to design adaptive keepalive headroom (owner: lex)
- eng-sre to add alert for connpool_exhaustion (owner: mike)
- add tenant-level graceful throttling policy to console (owner: product)

lex (eng-runtime): long-term tech bullets: 
- autoscale midfront pool based on rolling stream count
- circuit guard for auth-cache TTL rotations (staggered heartbeats)
- add per-route backpressure token bucket for huge batch endpoints

mike (eng-sre): logs/artifacts attached in case: trace=acme-8a3f, req=1767894321-acme, midfront pod: envoy-midfront-12-7f9b. saved pprof snapshot of fd usage.

olivia (support): labeling: customer-impacting, hostedapi, edge-502-504, embeddings. will update ticket. thanks all :thumbsup:

jamie (oncall): closing immediate incident, keeping watch for 2 hours. will reopen if metrics re-spike.

sarah (support): customer notified and happy with temporary mitigation. next steps scheduled in sprint.

olivia (support): friendly reminder to add KB link here when published and paste rollout plan for adaptive headroom.
